The per-seat pending-read guard still prevents accumulating reads behind a slow one. These refresh retries do not themselves send FYIs: large_seats ignores unknown sizes, neither crossing nor rearming a claim, so missing transcripts do not generate repeated large-seat notices. Remote/unbound/unsupported classifications are unchanged; only an actual NotFound enters this retry path.

Cost: for a permanently missing Copilot transcript this PA path performs at most one cold-path stat per minute, zero recursive walks; a request inside the shared 30-second negative cache does no filesystem lookup. Claude/OMP/Codex may perform one discovery per configured root on a PA retry outside that window, hence at most one search per missing seat per minute from this path, not zero walks. Other callers remain bounded by the adapter's 30-second negative cache. No new timer or process launch.

with_miss_ttl is public compiled code, not conditionally test-only, and must_use does not enforce test-only reachability. However, the only call site in the entire Rust workspace is this daemon regression; production constructs the adapter with the unchanged 30-second default. No production config, CLI or HTTP setting reaches the builder.
